name: Three-Tier Pricing
description: Premium dark pricing with a softly glowing featured plan, odometer-rolling prices, a sliding monthly/annual toggle and footnoted features.

props.name: plans
props.description: Plans in display order. Each has name, audience, monthly and annual prices, a CTA, an optional lead line and features. Set featured on one.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline, set in the display face.

props.name: titleAccent
props.description: Italic serif ending of the headline.

props.name: saving
props.description: Highlighted saving beside the billing toggle.

props.name: footnotes
props.description: Numbered notes under the plans. Reference them from a feature with note: 1, 2…

props.name: defaultBilling
props.description: Billing period selected on first render.
